sn24.2:1.2: kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave, sati kiṃ upādāya kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati :
sn24.2:1.4: bhagavammūlakā no bhante, dhammā …pe… bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
sn24.2:1.5: rūpe kho bhikkhave, sati rūpaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati :
sn24.2:1.10: viññāṇe sati, viññāṇaṃ upādāya, viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati :
sn24.2:2.3: aniccaṃ bhante, yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti? dukkhaṃ bhante, yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya: “etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā”ti? no hetaṃ bhante,
sn24.2:2.8: aniccaṃ bhante, yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti? dukkhaṃ bhante, yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ
sn24.2:2.9: api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya:
sn24.2:2.12: yampidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ, sutaṃ, mutaṃ, viññātaṃ, pattaṃ, pariyesitaṃ, anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tampi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā’ti?
sn24.2:2.14: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti?
sn24.2:2.16: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya :
sn24.2:3.1: yato kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa imesu chasu ṭhānesu kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti. dukkhe’pissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhasamudaye’pissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhanirodhe’pissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāyapissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti.
sn24.2:3.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, ariyasāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
